title: Shaping the Future for a Strategic Foresight
overview: In this course, participants will enhance their understanding and abilities in futures studies with a visionary and forward-thinking approach. They will acquire the skill to conceptualize reality and events through a systematic analysis of developments and decision-making processes in the context of global change.
Successful completion of this course will qualify attendees as experts in future business dynamics.
audience: This course is designed for leaders, managers, and senior professionals actively engaged in shaping, developing, or supporting the long-term planning of their department or organization. It is also suitable for individuals with an interest in gaining knowledge about futures studies
methodology: This course employs interactive case studies to illustrate various elements of futures studies. Additionally, it incorporates individual debriefs, group discussions, role-playing scenarios, videos, and presentations as part of the learning experience
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Describe the applications of futurology for companies and governments
Differentiate between possible, probable, and preferable futures
Apply scenario thinking through the use of futures wheel and environmental scanning
Identify the relationship between the foresight and strategy processes
Utilize futures studies for managing and mitigating risks
